topic: Responsive play vs buying developmental products
quick: Talk, read and play with your baby; expensive toys are not necessary.
Talking and singing can be enjoyable; recognition is not higher IQ.
caution: Do not use loud devices against the abdomen.

quick: Get adequate choline; extra amounts are not proven to make children smarter.
Important nutrient, but extra DHA did not clearly raise IQ in this trial.
caution: Do not infer prenatal nutrient needs from one endpoint.

quick: Prefer people and play; context matters when screens are used.
Support maternal health without promising a smarter baby or blaming ordinary stress.
Give safe opportunities to move; children develop at different rates.
caution: Awake supervised tummy time, back to sleep, no walkers as training, concerns prompt care.

quick: Use the languages your family speaks.
caution: Assess concerns across languages; no universal intelligence claim.
